newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Primadonna forecast raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Primadonna forecast raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Bruce Turner said he raised his estimates for Primadonna Resorts Inc "to reflect anticipated strong performance from New York, New York" hotel/casino in Las Vegas.
-- Turner raised his first quarter estimate to $0.27 a share from $0.24 a share. He raised his full year 1997 estimate to $1.20/shr from $1.05 and full year 1998 to $1.25/shr from $1.10.
-- He maintained his hold rating on the stock.
-- New York New York is 50 percent owned by Primadonna and 50 percent by MGM Grand Inc.
